svg.text: BeliefLab | follow the probability mass, then add the rewards
Supplied probe-then-exploit policy. Uniform prior. Two decisions, discount 1, identity transitions.
Each observation branch: reach 1/2 * conditional reward 4/5 = reward mass 2/5.
Forward value: -1/10 + 2/5 + 2/5 = 7/10 = belief dot policy alpha (7/10, 7/10).
Where is this fixed probe tree optimal?
Where is the fixed exploit-0-twice tree optimal?
This tree is NOT the optimized
b = probability of hidden state 0. Colored bands show every zero-regret belief, including boundaries.
Terminal history mass sums to 1. Impossible branches have zero mass and null conditional beliefs/rewards.
Exact expectation in the supplied model, not sampled execution, learned calibration or real-world safety.
